purpose: Order 116 hypothesis-1 A/B: return an exact-first, case-insensitive basename recovery candidate when a model-selected local path differs only by filename case.
change_scope: Preserve every v118 action, schema, ranking rule, and runtime behavior. When an explicit model-selected local path does not exist, scan for exact-case basename candidates first. Only if none exist, return bounded case-insensitive basename candidates with an explicit retry option. Never open, read, or execute a recovery candidate automatically; the model must select a returned exact path and issue a new tool call. No task identity, dataset order, instruction fingerprint, fixed filename, golden content, evaluator state, Runner rerouting, or argument rewriting participates in recovery.

protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and strictly audit this hypothesis-1 A/B, classify the new failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. Try at most two further materially different generic hypotheses with one targeted A/B each. If hypothesis 3 also fails, mark Order 116 task_blocked and immediately advance.

implementation_evidence.parent_attempt_diagnosis: The untouched baseline selected document.read_file with a basename that differed from the existing document only by letter case. Existing recovery searched for case-sensitive basename equality and returned zero candidates. Qwen then alternated the same rejected read with one repeated catalog query. The no-progress guard stopped steps 2-9 after 43.585 Agent seconds; the original evaluator returned 0.0.
implementation_evidence.candidate_bundle_hash_method: SHA-256 of the ordered sha256sum line for the modified production module listed above.
implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 18 path, candidate, and document-reader tests passed. The complete unit suite reported 1790 passed. Ruff on active source and tests, compileall, project layout and deployment leakage checks, frozen-v1 SHA256SUMS, and the OSWorld commit/evaluator-tree check passed.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual: A structurally unrelated Writer document uses different words, directory roots, and capitalization. The test proves that a missing case-variant path returns one candidate and an explicit model retry option without a second downstream call. Existing tests prove that exact-case candidates continue to take precedence over case-insensitive variants and that ambiguous exact candidates are never chosen automatically. The counterfactual test source SHA-256 is d55fdd41d8a5a026e26228c838296dabf7ab6cd608206cb28ffe8fefd60e719c. No task ID, dataset order, task source basename, requested output basename, golden content, or evaluator value appears in production code or the new counterfactual.

selection.method: first and only targeted generic A/B for hypothesis 1 on Order 116
